description: This source file defines in-memory logging classes for testing purposes, including a MemoryLogger, MemoryLoggerProvider, and configuration class, used within the PdfSharp.TestHelper namespace.

classes.name: MemoryLogger
classes.description: A logger implementation that stores log entries in memory for inspection.

classes.name: MemoryLoggerProvider
classes.description: Creates and manages in-memory MemoryLogger instances for different categories.

classes.name: MemoryLoggerConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration settings for MemoryLogger instances, primarily the minimum log level.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with specified log level, event, state, and exception, and stores it in memory.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the provided log level is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: BeginScope
methods.description: Begins a logging scope; returns default in this implementation.

methods.name: MemoryLoggerProvider
methods.description: Constructor setting up the provider with a minimum log level.

methods.name: CreateLogger
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a logger for a given category.

methods.name: GetLoggers
methods.description: Returns all loggers managed by this provider.

methods.name: GetLogger
methods.description: Retrieves a specific logger by category name.
